exclusions.name: other hospitals or blood recipients
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's received units. Other entities do not affect the hospital's received shipments.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz's actions
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection or shipping; her actions do not change the number of units received.

exclusions.name: any usage or wastage at the centre
exclusions.why_safe: The centre's stock is only relevant to whether it can ship 150 units; usage or wastage could affect that, but the question is about hospital receipts, not centre operations.

uncertainties.meaning: The rate at which the hospital uses blood units between Monday and Friday noon is unknown. This affects the net units held at the deadline.
Whether the collection drive operates exactly as scheduled (9-5 each day) or has any closures or reduced hours is unknown.
The exact stock at the centre after the Tuesday shipment is unknown because it depends on collection amounts and any other usage or transfers not mentioned.
Whether the centre has at least 150 units to ship on Thursday is unknown, as it depends on collections and any other demands.
The exact arrival time of the Thursday shipment is unknown; it may arrive before or after the Friday noon deadline.
